title: Norwegian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew from Norway, featuring tender lamb and a rich broth. Perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Season the lamb with earthy salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the broth, wine, and thyme, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
